title_en: Text-Driven Fusion for Infrared and Visible Images: Achieving Image Scene Adaptation on Hyperbolic Space
title_zh: 红外与可见光图像的文本驱动融合：在双曲空间实现图像场景自适应

sentences.en: Infrared and visible image fusion aims to integrate complementary modalities, while existing Euclidean methods impose rigid distance metrics that distort multi-modal interactions and parent-to-child semantic hierarchies.
sentences.zh: 红外与可见光图像融合旨在整合互补的模态，而现有的欧氏方法强加了刚性的距离度量，扭曲了多模态交互以及父子语义层级。

sentences.en: To overcome these limitations, we introduce a text-driven fusion framework empowered by hyperbolic manifold learning.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们引入了一种由双曲流形学习赋能的文本驱动融合框架。

sentences.en: During training, BLIP-extracted text prompts serve as topological anchors within the hyperbolic space, guiding vision-attribute alignment through hyperbolic embeddings that naturally accommodate varying semantic granularities.
sentences.zh: 在训练阶段，BLIP 提取的文本提示充当双曲空间中的拓扑锚点，通过自然适应不同语义粒度的双曲嵌入来引导视觉-属性对齐。

sentences.en: By exploiting the exponential volume growth dictated by the Poincaré ball's negative curvature, this approach seamlessly embeds hierarchical trees to encode coarse-to-fine semantics without metric saturation, while the vast peripheral space prevents texture distortion during cross-modal fusion.
sentences.zh: 通过利用 Poincaré 球负曲率所决定的指数体积增长，该方法无缝地嵌入层级树来编码从粗到细的语义而不会出现度量饱和，同时广阔的周缘空间在跨模态融合期间防止纹理扭曲。

sentences.en: At inference, the fusion process autonomously adapts to input content using the learned text-attribute priors, completely eliminating the need for textual input.
sentences.zh: 在推断时，融合过程利用学到的文本-属性先验自主适应输入内容，完全消除了对文本输入的需求。

sentences.en: Experimental results show our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches on benchmark datasets, with code available at https://github.com/Shaoyun2023/TEDFusion.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，我们的方法在基准数据集上优于最先进的方法，代码可在 https://github.com/Shaoyun2023/TEDFusion 获取。

title_en: TextAtlas5M: A Large-Scale Dataset for Long Text Image Generation
title_zh: TextAtlas5M：用于长文本图像生成的大规模数据集

sentences.en: Text-conditioned image generation has made rapid progress, yet rendering images with long-form text remains challenging due to the limitations of existing datasets, which predominantly focus on short and simple text.
sentences.zh: 文本条件图像生成已取得快速进展，然而呈现出长形式文本的图像仍然具有挑战性，原因在于现有数据集的局限，这些数据集主要聚焦于简短且简单的文本。

sentences.en: We introduce TextAtlas5M, a large-scale dataset designed to evaluate long-text rendering, where “long text” encompasses not only textual length but also layout complexity and semantic richness.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 TextAtlas5M，一个为评估长文本渲染而设计的大规模数据集，其中“长文本”不仅涵盖文本长度，还涵盖布局复杂性和语义丰富度。

sentences.en: TextAtlas5M contains 5 million generated and collected images across diverse data types, enabling comprehensive evaluation of large-scale generative models.
sentences.zh: TextAtlas5M 包含跨多样数据类型的 500 万张生成和收集的图像，支持对大规模生成模型的全面评估。

sentences.en: We further curate 4,000 human-improved test cases (TextAtlasEval) spanning four domains, forming one of the most extensive benchmarks for text rendering.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步整理了跨越四个领域的 4,000 个人工改进测试用例（TextAtlasEval），形成了最全面的文本渲染基准之一。

sentences.en: Evaluations show that TextAtlas5M poses substantial challenges even for state-of-the-art proprietary models (e.g., GPT-4o), with significantly larger gaps observed for open-source models.
sentences.zh: 评估表明，即便对最先进的专有模型（例如 GPT-4o），TextAtlas5M 也构成重大挑战，而开源模型则表现出显著更大的差距。

sentences.en: Training on TextAtlas5M consistently improves text rendering  for both diffusion-based and autoregressive models, demonstrating  its effectiveness for advancing text-rich image generation.
sentences.zh: 在 TextAtlas5M 上的训练持续改进基于扩散和自回归两类模型的文本渲染，证明了其对推进文本丰富图像生成的有效性。

title_en: TextME: Bridging Unseen Modalities Through Text Descriptions
title_zh: TextME：通过文本描述桥接未见过的模态

sentences.en: Expanding multimodal representations to novel modalities is constrained by reliance on largescale paired datasets (e.g., text–image, text–audio, text–3D, text–molecule), which are costly and often infeasible in domains requiring expert annotation such as medical imaging and molecular analysis.
sentences.zh: 将多模态表示扩展到新模态，受制于对大规模配对数据集（例如文本-图像、文本-音频、文本-3D、文本-分子）的依赖，而在需要专家标注的领域（如医学影像和分子分析）中，这些数据集成本高昂且往往不可行。

sentences.en: We introduce TextME, to the best of our knowledge the first modality expansion framework based on text-only training, projecting diverse modalities into LLM embedding space as a unified anchor.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 TextME，据我们所知，这是第一个基于纯文本训练的模态扩展框架，它将各种模态投影到 LLM 嵌入空间中，作为统一锚点。

sentences.en: Our approach exploits the geometric structure of pretrained contrastive encoders to enable zero-shot cross-modal transfer using only text descriptions, without paired supervision.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法利用预训练对比编码器的几何结构，仅使用文本描述就能实现零样本跨模态迁移，而无需配对监督。

sentences.en: We empirically validate that such consistent modality gaps exist across image, video, audio, 3D, X-ray, and molecular domains, demonstrating that text-only training can preserve substantial performance of pretrained encoders.
sentences.zh: 我们实证验证了这种一致性的模态差距存在于图像、视频、音频、3D、X 射线和分子等领域，表明纯文本训练可以保留预训练编码器的相当大部分性能。

sentences.en: We further show that our framework enables emergent cross-modal retrieval between modality pairs not explicitly aligned during training (e.g., audioto-image, 3D-to-image).
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，我们的框架能够在训练期间未显式对齐的模态对之间实现涌现的跨模态检索（例如音频到图像、3D 到图像）。

sentences.en: These results establish text-only projection training as a practical alternative to paired supervision for modality expansion.
sentences.zh: 这些结果确立了纯文本投影训练作为配对监督在实际工程中的替代方案。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://soyeonhh.github.io/TextME/.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://soyeonhh.github.io/TextME/ 获取。

title_en: TextMesh4D: Zero-shot Text-to-4D Mesh Generation
title_zh: TextMesh4D：零样本文本到 4D 网格生成

sentences.en: Large-scale, high-quality dynamic 3D (4D) assets are essential for learning physically grounded representations, but remain costly to capture and annotate at scale.
sentences.zh: 大型、高质量的动态 3D（4D）资产对于学习具有物理基础的表示至关重要，但大规模采集和标注的成本仍然高昂。

sentences.en: This limits the viability of supervised 4D learning and motivates zero-shot text-to-4D generation leveraging pretrained diffusion priors.
sentences.zh: 这限制了有监督 4D 学习的可行性，并促使人们利用预训练的扩散先验进行零样本文本到 4D 生成。

sentences.en: To model complex dynamics, prior methods typically adopt implicit 3D representations (e.g., NeRFs or 3DGS) for their deformation capacity.
sentences.zh: 为建模复杂动力学，先前方法通常采用隐式 3D 表示（例如 NeRF 或 3DGS），以利用其形变能力。

sentences.en: However, their implicit nature provides limited control over surface topology, which hinders high-fidelity geometry and makes temporally coherent surface reconstruction challenging.
sentences.zh: 然而，其隐式特性对表面拓扑的控制有限，这阻碍了高保真几何，并使时间一致的表面重建具有挑战性。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we explore zero-shot text-to-4D mesh generation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些局限，我们探索了零样本文本到 4D 网格生成。

sentences.en: However, a structural mismatch arises when combining diffusion-based guidance with topology-constrained meshes: the guidance is noisy and spatially inconsistent, while meshes impose severe topological constraints, making direct vertex-level deformation unstable.
sentences.zh: 然而，当将基于扩散的引导与受拓扑约束的网格相结合时，会出现结构性不匹配：引导是含噪的且在空间上不一致，而网格施加了严格的拓扑约束，使直接的顶点级形变不稳定。

sentences.en: In this paper, we introduce TextMesh4D, the first zero-shot framework for text-to-4D that directly generates dynamic meshes by addressing the above challenge at two complementary levels.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们介绍了 TextMesh4D，第一个零样本文本到 4D 框架，它通过在两个互补层面应对上述挑战来直接生成动态网格。

sentences.en: Geometrically, we shift deformation modeling from vertices to faces via a Jacobian Deformation Field (JDF), enabling topology-aware surface reconstruction through an integrability-enforcing integration formulation.
sentences.zh: 在几何层面，我们通过雅可比形变场（JDF）将形变建模从顶点转移到面，通过一个强制可积性的积分公式实现拓扑感知的表面重建。

sentences.en: Semantically, we propose a Local-Global Semantic Regularizer (LGSR) that preserves identity over time by jointly constraining local deformation plausibility and global shape consistency.
sentences.zh: 在语义层面，我们提出了一种局部-全局语义正则化器（LGSR），通过联合约束局部形变的合理性和全局形状的一致性，来随时间保持身份一致性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art temporal consistency, structural fidelity, and visual quality, while remaining efficient on a single 24GB GPU.
sentences.zh: 大量实验展示了最先进的时间一致性、结构保真度和视觉质量，同时仅需单个 24GB GPU 即可高效运行。

title_en: TextResNet: Decoupling and Routing Optimization Signals in Compound AI Systems via Deep Residual Tuning
title_zh: TextResNet：通过深度残差调优解耦并路由复合 AI 系统中的优化信号

sentences.en: Textual Gradient-style optimizers (TextGrad) enable gradient-like feedback propagation through compound AI systems.
sentences.zh: 文本梯度式优化器（TextGrad）能够通过复合 AI 系统传播类似梯度的反馈。

sentences.en: However, they do not work well for deep chains.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们不适用于深层链路。

sentences.en: The root cause of this limitation stems from the *Semantic Entanglement* problem in these extended workflows.
sentences.zh: 这一局限的根本原因源于这些扩展工作流中的*语义纠缠*问题。

sentences.en: In standard textual backpropagation, feedback signals mix local critiques with upstream contexts, leading to *Attribution Ambiguity*.
sentences.zh: 在标准的文本反向传播中，反馈信号将局部批评与上游上下文混合，导致*归因歧义*。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose TextResNet, a framework that reformulates the optimization process to achieve precise signal routing via four key innovations.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出了 TextResNet，一个通过四项关键创新重构优化流程以实现精确信号路由的框架。

sentences.en: Firstly, in the forward pass, it enforces Additive Semantic Deltas to preserve an Identity Highway for gradient flow.
sentences.zh: 首先，在前向传播中，它强制施加可加性语义增量，以保留用于梯度流的恒等高速公路。

sentences.en: Secondly, in the backward pass, it introduces Semantic Gradient Decomposition via a Semantic Projector to disentangle feedback into causally independent subspaces.
sentences.zh: 其次，在后向传播中，它通过语义投影器引入语义梯度分解，将反馈解耦到因果独立的子空间中。

sentences.en: Thirdly, it implements Causal Routing, which routes projected signals to their specific components.
sentences.zh: 第三，它实现因果路由，即将投影后的信号路由到各自的组件。

sentences.en: Finally, it performs Density-Aware Optimization Scheduling to leverage the disentangled signals to dynamically allocate resources to key system bottlenecks.
sentences.zh: 最后，它执行密度感知的优化调度，利用解耦后的信号将资源动态分配到关键的系统瓶颈上。

sentences.en: Our results show that TextResNet not only achieves superior performance compared to TextGrad, but also exhibits remarkable stability for agentic tasks in compound AI systems where baselines collapse.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，TextResNet 不仅相比 TextGrad 取得了更优的性能，而且在基线失败的复合 AI 系统的智能体任务中展现出显著的稳定性。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/JeanDiable/TextResNet.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/JeanDiable/TextResNet 获取。

title_en: Textual Stochastic Gradient Descent: Discrete Optimization of External Memory for Reasoning Language Agents
title_zh: 文本随机梯度下降：面向推理语言智能体的外部记忆离散优化

sentences.en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) possess strong reasoning capabilities, enabling them to learn continuously from experience without parametric retraining remains an open challenge.
sentences.zh: 虽然大型语言模型（LLM）拥有强大的推理能力，但让它们在不进行参数重训练的情况下从经验中持续学习，仍然是一个待解决的挑战。

sentences.en: Existing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches typically treat memory as a static or append-only corpus, leading to "memory saturation," where accumulating noise and redundant information degrade performance over time.
sentences.zh: 现有的检索增强生成（RAG）方法通常将记忆视为静态或仅追加的语料库，导致“记忆饱和”，即噪声和冗余信息的累积会随时间的推移降低性能。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose an Experience Library Optimization framework that treats the agent's external memory, which we call the experience library, as a learnable parameter under an explicit capacity budget.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了经验库优化框架，它将智能体的外部记忆（我们称之为经验库）视为在显式容量预算下的可学习参数。

sentences.en: We introduce Textual Stochastic Gradient Descent (TSGD), a discrete optimization algorithm that refines this library via failure-driven Add, Edit, and Delete operations.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了文本随机梯度下降（TSGD），一种离散优化算法，通过由失败驱动的新增、编辑和删除操作来优化这个经验库。

sentences.en: TSGD estimates "textual gradients" through self-reflection and uses a dual-verification mechanism to ensure generalization, which prevents overfitting to local errors.
sentences.zh: TSGD 通过自我反思估计“文本梯度”，并使用双重验证机制确保泛化，从而防止过拟合到局部错误。

sentences.en: Empirical results on MATH and AIME benchmarks show that TSGD achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving accuracy by up to $18.7\%$ over zero-shot baselines and substantially outperforming static RAG, while keeping a compact memory footprint (compressing hundreds of experiences into $\approx 30$ high-utility rules).
sentences.zh: 在 MATH 和 AIME 基准上的实证结果表明，TSGD 取得了最先进的性能，相较零样本基准将准确率提升多达 $18.7\%$，并大幅优于静态 RAG，同时保持紧凑的内存占用（将数百条经验压缩为 $\approx 30$ 条高效用的规则）。

title_en: Textual Supervision Enhances Geospatial Representations in Vision-Language Models
title_zh: 文本监督增强视觉-语言模型中的地理空间表示

sentences.en: Geospatial understanding is a critical yet underexplored dimension in the development of machine learning systems for tasks such as image geolocation and spatial reasoning.
sentences.zh: 地理空间理解是面向图像地理定位和空间推理等任务的机器学习系统开发中的一个关键但尚未充分探索的维度。

sentences.en: In this work, we analyze the geospatial representations acquired by three model families: vision-only architectures (e.g., ViT), vision-language models (e.g., CLIP), and large-scale multimodal foundation models (e.g., LLaVA, Qwen, and Gemma).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们分析了三个模型家族所获取的地理空间表示：纯视觉架构（例如 ViT）、视觉-语言模型（例如 CLIP）以及大规模多模态基座模型（例如 LLaVA、Qwen 和 Gemma）。

sentences.en: By evaluating across image clusters, including people, landmarks, and everyday objects, grouped based on the degree of localizability, we reveal systematic gaps in spatial accuracy and show that textual supervision enhances the learning of geospatial representations.
sentences.zh: 通过跨图像聚类进行评估，包括按可定位性程度分组的人、地标和日常物体，我们揭示了空间精度方面的系统性差距，并表明文本监督增强了地理空间表示的学习。

sentences.en: Our findings suggest the role of language as an effective complementary modality for encoding spatial context and multimodal learning as a key direction for advancing geospatial AI.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，语言可以作为编码空间语境的有效互补模态，而多模态学习是推进地理空间 AI 的关键方向。

title_en: TF-FACE: Time-Frequency Fusion Learning via Frequency-Domain Adaptive and Controllable Enhancement for Trajectory Prediction
title_zh: TF-FACE：通过频域自适应且可控增强进行时频融合学习的轨迹预测

sentences.en: Accurately predicting the future trajectories of traffic participants is critical for safe, efficient, and human-friendly autonomous driving.
sentences.zh: 准确预测交通参与者的未来轨迹，对于安全、高效且以人为本的自动驾驶至关重要。

sentences.en: Existing learning-based trajectory prediction methods are predominantly time-domain and insufficiently exploit latent frequency information, which limits their capability to capture low-frequency long-term dependencies and high-frequency short-term dynamics.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于学习的轨迹预测方法主要立足时域，未能充分利用潜在的频率信息，这限制了它们捕获低频长期依赖和高频短期动态的能力。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose TF-FACE, a time-frequency learning framework via frequency-domain adaptive and controllable enhancement.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出了 TF-FACE，一个通过频域自适应且可控增强实现的时频学习框架。

sentences.en: TF-FACE introduces a fusion encoder with learnable gated frequency-domain attention that adaptively manipulates band-specific features for trajectory prediction.
sentences.zh: TF-FACE 引入了一个具有可学习门控频域注意力的融合编码器，该编码器自适应地操控特定频带的特征以用于轨迹预测。

sentences.en: Building on the fused representation, we design a dual-stage decoder and a band-specific time–frequency dual-consistency loss to enable controllable decoupling and coupling across long- and short-term temporal scales, global and local scales, and then generate final multimodal predictions.
sentences.zh: 在融合表示的基础上，我们设计了一个双阶段解码器和一个频带特异的时频双一致性损失，以实现跨长期和短期时间尺度、全局和局部尺度的可控解耦与耦合，进而生成最终的多模态预测。

sentences.en: Experiments on Argoverse 1 demonstrate that TF-FACE achieves state-of-the-art accuracy, while maintaining real-time inference for autonomous driving.
sentences.zh: 在 Argoverse 1 上的实验表明，TF-FACE 实现了最先进的准确率，同时保持自动驾驶所需的实时推理。

sentences.en: Additional experiments are conducted on Argoverse 2, further validating TF-FACE's performance and generalizability.
sentences.zh: 我们还在 Argoverse 2 上进行了额外实验，进一步验证了 TF-FACE 的性能和泛化能力。

title_en: TFRBench: A Reasoning Benchmark for Evaluating Forecasting Systems
title_zh: TFRBench：用于评估预测系统的推理基准

sentences.en: We introduce TFRBench, the first benchmark designed to evaluate the reasoning capabilities of forecasting systems.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 TFRBench，第一个旨在评估预测系统推理能力的基准。

sentences.en: Traditionally, time-series forecasting has been evaluated solely on numerical accuracy, treating foundation models as "black boxes."
sentences.zh: 传统上，时间序列预测仅以数值准确度进行评估，将基础模型视为“黑盒”。

sentences.en: Unlike existing benchmarks, TFRBench provides a protocol for evaluating the reasoning generated by forecasting systems--specifically their analysis of cross-channel dependencies, trends, and external events.
sentences.zh: 与现有基准不同，TFRBench 提供了一种评估预测系统所生成推理的协议——具体而言，即它们对跨通道依赖、趋势和外部事件的分析。

sentences.en: To enable this, we propose a systematic multi-agent framework that utilizes an iterative verification loop to synthesize numerically grounded reasoning traces.
sentences.zh: 为实现这一点，我们提出了一个系统化的多智能体框架，利用迭代验证循环来合成具有数值基础的推理轨迹。

sentences.en: Spanning ten datasets across five domains, our evaluation confirms that this reasoning is causally effective; useful for evaluation; and prompting LLMs with our generated traces significantly improves forecasting accuracy compared to direct numerical prediction (e.g., avg. $\sim40.2$% $\rightarrow$ $\sim56.6$%), validating the quality of our reasoning.
sentences.zh: 该评估横跨五个领域的十个数据集，我们的评估确认：这种推理在因果上是有效的、对评估有用的；与直接数值预测相比，用我们生成的推理轨迹提示 LLM 能显著提升预测准确率（例如平均 $\sim40.2$% $\rightarrow$ $\sim56.6$%），从而验证了我们推理的质量。

sentences.en: Conversely, benchmarking experiments reveal that off-the-shelf LLMs consistently struggle with both reasoning (lower LLM-as-a-Judge scores) and numerical forecasting, frequently failing to capture domain-specific dynamics.
sentences.zh: 相反，基准实验揭示，现成的 LLM 在推理（较低的 LLM-as-a-Judge 分数）和数值预测两方面都一直表现不佳，常常无法捕获领域特异的动态。

sentences.en: TFRBench thus establishes a new standard for interpretable, reasoning-based evaluation in time-series forecasting.
sentences.zh: 因此，TFRBench 为时间序列预测中的可解释、基于推理的评估确立了新的标准。

sentences.en: Our benchmark is available at: https://tfrbench.github.io
sentences.zh: 我们的基准可在以下网址获取：https://tfrbench.github.io

topic: Probabilistic Methods->Monte Carlo and Sampling Methods
title_en: TFTF: Training-Free Targeted Flow for Conditional Sampling
title_zh: TFTF：用于条件采样的免训练定向流

sentences.en: We propose a training-free conditional sampling method for flow matching models based on importance sampling.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种基于重要性采样的流匹配模型的免训练条件采样方法。

sentences.en: Because a naïve application of importance sampling suffers from weight degeneracy in high-dimensional settings, we modify and incorporate a resampling technique in sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) during intermediate stages of the generation process.
sentences.zh: 由于朴素地应用重要性采样在高维设定中会遭受权重退化之苦，我们在生成过程的中间阶段修改并融合了序列蒙特卡洛（SMC）中的重采样技术。

sentences.en: To encourage the generated samples to diverge along distinct trajectories, we derive a stochastic flow with adjustable noise strength to replace the deterministic flow at the intermediate stage.
sentences.zh: 为鼓励生成的样本沿不同轨迹发散，我们推导出一种具有可调噪声强度的随机流，用于在中间阶段取代确定性流。

sentences.en: Our framework requires no additional training, while providing theoretical guarantees of asymptotic accuracy.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架无需额外训练，同时提供渐近准确性的理论保证。

sentences.en: Experimentally, our method significantly outperforms existing approaches on conditional sampling tasks for MNIST and CIFAR-10.
sentences.zh: 在实验上，我们的方法在 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10 的条件采样任务上显著优于现有方法。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate the applicability of our approach in higher-dimensional, multimodal settings through text-to-image generation experiments on CelebA-HQ.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步通过 CelebA-HQ 上的文本到图像生成实验，展示了我们方法在高维、多模态设定中的应用性。

title_en: TG-RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Framework for Reasoning Guidance in Specialized Domains
title_zh: TG-RAG：面向专业领域推理引导的检索增强框架

sentences.en: Enhancing Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) for specialized domains remains a critical challenge.
sentences.zh: 增强面向专业领域的大型推理模型（LRM）仍然是一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: While recent industrial frameworks attempt to encapsulate Standard Operating Procedures into modular "skills" for dynamic retrieval, utilizing them via context engineering often proves insufficient for complex workflows, leading to "Cognitive Drift."
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的工业框架尝试将标准操作流程封装为模块化的“技能”以供动态检索，但通过上下文工程来利用它们，往往不足以应对复杂工作流，导致“认知漂移”。

sentences.en: To mitigate this, we propose $\textbf{Thought Guidance-Retrieval Augmented Generation (TG-RAG)}$, a Retrieval-Augmented framework that effectively steers the generation process without relying solely on the model's self-correction.
sentences.zh: 为缓解这一问题，我们提出了$\textbf{Thought Guidance-Retrieval Augmented Generation（TG-RAG）}$，一个检索增强框架，在不单纯依赖模型自我纠正的情况下有效地引导生成过程。

sentences.en: Built upon an Expert Procedure Graph (EPG) that formalizes unstructured SOPs, the framework uniquely employs a dynamic $\textbf{``Interrupt-Retrieve-Generate" (IRG)}$ mechanism to actively inject step-specific directives into the model's reasoning process.
sentences.zh: 该框架构建于一个将非结构化 SOP 形式化的专家程序图（EPG）之上，独特地采用一种动态的$\textbf{“Interrupt-Retrieve-Generate”（IRG）}$机制，将逐步的特异指令主动注入模型的推理过程。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations show that TG-RAG achieves competitive performance, demonstrating advantages in specialized domains by ensuring faithful adherence to domain SOPs.
sentences.zh: 大量评估表明，TG-RAG 取得了具有竞争力的性能，通过确保对领域 SOP 的忠实遵循，在专业领域展现出优势。

authors.institution: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

title_en: TGPO: Efficient Policy Optimization through Sequence Anchor and Information Gating
title_zh: TGPO：通过序列锚点与信息门控实现高效策略优化

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become an important paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models, while it also involves a persistent tradeoff between optimization stability and learning efficiency.
sentences.zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为增强大型语言模型推理能力的重要范式，但它同时也涉及优化稳定性与学习效率之间的持续权衡。

sentences.en: Token-level importance weighting supports fine-grained credit assignment, but it often introduces high variance and unstable parameter updates, whereas sequence-level optimization provides more stable learning dynamics while failing to fully exploit informative local signals.
sentences.zh: 词元级重要性加权支持细粒度的信用分配，但常常引入高方差和不稳定的参数更新，而序列级优化提供了更稳定的学习动态，却未能充分利用有信息量的局部信号。

sentences.en: We introduce **T**rust-**G**ated **P**olicy **O**ptimization (TGPO), an efficient policy optimization framework that integrates two complementary mechanisms, namely *sequence anchors* and *information gates*.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了 **T**rust-**G**ated **P**olicy **O**ptimization（TGPO），一个高效的策略优化框架，它整合了两种互补机制，即*序列锚点*和*信息门*。

sentences.en: TGPO aligns token-wise updates with a stable sequence-level reference, which reduces the influence of extreme local likelihood fluctuations on the gradient, and a trust-based information gate adaptively modulates the contribution of token-level signals.
sentences.zh: TGPO 将词元级别的更新与稳定的序列级参考对齐，从而降低极端局部似然波动对梯度的影响，而基于信任的信息门则自适应地调节词元级信号的贡献。

sentences.en: By retaining and reweighting gradients from imperfect trajectories rather than excluding them, TGPO improves gradient utilization and sample efficiency while maintaining stable optimization behavior.
sentences.zh: 通过保留并重新加权来自不完美轨迹的梯度，而非将其排除，TGPO 在保持稳定优化行为的同时提升了梯度利用率和样本效率。

sentences.en: Empirical results across seven mathematical reasoning datasets and multiple model scales show that TGPO consistently enhances learning efficiency and overall performance in outcome-supervised reinforcement learning settings.
sentences.zh: 跨七个数学推理数据集和多种模型规模的实证结果表明，TGPO 在结果监督的强化学习设定中持续提升了学习效率和整体性能。

title_en: TGV-KV: Text-Grounded KV Eviction for Vision-Language Models
title_zh: TGV-KV：面向视觉-语言模型的文本接地的 KV 驱逐

sentences.en: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) inherit the auto-regressive generation paradigm and cache the keys and values (KV) of all previous tokens to accelerate inference, resulting in memory consumption that scales linearly with context length.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）继承了自回归生成范式，并缓存所有先前词元的键和值（KV）以加速推断，导致内存消耗随上下文长度线性增长。

sentences.en: This issue is particularly pronounced in VLMs due to substantial redundancy in the visual modality.
sentences.zh: 这一问题在 VLM 中尤为显著，因为视觉模态中存在大量冗余。

sentences.en: Although KV cache eviction approaches can effectively reduce inference memory, they often incur significant performance degradation in VLMs, as most are designed for language models and overlook the inherent gap between text and vision.
sentences.zh: 虽然 KV 缓存驱逐方法可以有效减少推断内存，但它们往往在 VLM 中造成显著的性能下降，因为大多数方法是为语言模型设计的，忽视了文本与视觉之间的固有差距。

sentences.en: By systematically analyzing the modality gap in VLMs in this work, we argue that the importance of visual information should be grounded in textual guidance and accordingly propose a **T**ext-**G**rounded KV Eviction method for **V**LMs (**TGV-KV**).
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，通过系统地分析 VLM 中的模态差距，我们认为视觉信息的重要性应当以文本引导为基础，并相应提出了面向 VLM 的**T**ext-**G**rounded KV Eviction 方法（**TGV-KV**）。

sentences.en: TGV-KV comprises three submodules: *(1) Text-Vision Budgeting (TVB)* assigns budget to each layer based on the mutual information interaction.
sentences.zh: TGV-KV 包含三个子模块：*(1) Text-Vision Budgeting（TVB）* 基于互信息交互为每一层分配预算。

sentences.en: *(2) Text-Weighted Ranking (TWR)* assesses the priority of text and ranks vision importance based on weighted text-image attention.
sentences.zh: *(2) Text-Weighted Ranking（TWR）* 评估文本的优先级，并基于加权文本-图像注意力对视觉重要性进行排序。

sentences.en: *(3) Text-Prioritised Retention (TPR)* policy strategically preserves text KV to avoid acute information loss.
sentences.zh: *(3) Text-Prioritised Retention（TPR）* 策略性地保留文本 KV，以避免急剧的信息损失。

sentences.en: We evaluate TGV-KV across five models with different sizes and architectures, showing that TGV-KV preserves 99.2% full-KV accuracy on the VizWiz-VQA task with LLaVA-NeXT and boosts end-to-end throughput by 52.6% with an extreme retention budget of 5%.
sentences.zh: 我们跨五种不同规模和架构的模型评估了 TGV-KV，表明 TGV-KV 在 LLaVA-NeXT 上的 VizWiz-VQA 任务中保持了 99.2% 的全 KV 准确率，并在 5% 的极端保留预算下将端到端吞吐量提升了 52.6%。

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: The (Marginal) Value of a Search Ad: An Online Causal Framework for Repeated Second-price Auctions
title_zh: 一条搜索广告的（边际）价值：面向重复二次价格拍卖的在线因果框架

sentences.en: Existing auto-bidding algorithms in digital advertising often treat the value of an ad opportunity as the revenue obtained when an ad is shown and/or clicked, and bid accordingly.
sentences.zh: 数字广告中现有的自动竞价算法常常将广告机会的价值视为广告展示和/或被点击时获得的收入，并据此出价。

sentences.en: This can lead to wasteful spending because the true value is the marginal gain from paid exposure: even without winning a sponsored slot, an advertiser may still earn revenue via an organic search result (e.g., on Google or Amazon).
sentences.zh: 这可能导致浪费性支出，因为真正价值来自付费曝光的边际收益：即使没有赢得赞助位，广告主仍可能通过自然搜索结果（例如在 Google 或 Amazon 上）获得收入。

sentences.en: Motivated by recent work, we model ad value as a treatment effect—the outcome difference between winning and losing the auction—and study online learning for bidding in second-price (Vickrey) auctions under this causal perspective.
sentences.zh: 受近期工作启发，我们将广告价值建模为一种处理效应——赢得与输掉拍卖之间的结果差异——并在这一因果视角下研究二次价格（Vickrey）拍卖中的出价在线学习。

sentences.en: We develop algorithms that attain rate-optimal regret under several feedback models.
sentences.zh: 我们开发了在多种反馈模型下达到速率最优遗憾的算法。

sentences.en: A key ingredient exploits the information revealed by the second-price payment rule, which strictly improves regret relative to analogous learning problems in first-price auctions.
sentences.zh: 一个关键要素利用了二次价格支付规则所揭示的信息，这相对一价拍卖中的类似学习问题严格改进了遗憾。

authors.name: Yuan YAO
authors.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

title_en: The Abstraction Gap in Vision-Language Causal Reasoning
title_zh: 视觉-语言因果推理中的抽象差距

sentences.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) generate fluent causal explanations, but current evaluations cannot distinguish linguistic plausibility from faithful causal reasoning.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言模型（VLM）能生成流畅的因果解释，但当前评估方法无法区分语言合理性与忠实的因果推理。

sentences.en: We introduce a dual-probe methodology that isolates these properties.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一种双重探针方法，将这两种性质分离开来。

sentences.en: The Text-Only Probe measures linguistic quality.
sentences.zh: 纯文本探针衡量语言质量。

sentences.en: The Chain-Text Probe requires models to first generate explicit causal chains.
sentences.zh: 链式文本探针要求模型首先生成显式的因果链。

sentences.en: The Abstraction Gap (AG) metric quantifies the normalized performance difference.
sentences.zh: 抽象差距（AG）指标量化了归一化后的性能差异。

sentences.en: Evaluating eight VLMs on CAGE (Causal Abstraction Gap Evaluation), a benchmark of 49,500 questions across 5,500 images spanning Pearl's causal hierarchy, we find seven models exhibit AG exceeding 0.50 with text scores of 6--8 but chain scores below 2.5. Fine-tuning on 45,000 chain-annotated examples fails to close the gap.
sentences.zh: 我们在 CAGE（因果抽象差距评估）上评估了八个 VLM，该基准包含跨 5,500 张图像的 49,500 道题，横跨 Pearl 的因果层级，发现七个模型的 AG 超过 0.50，文本得分在 6-8 之间，而链式得分低于 2.5。在 45,000 个带链式标注的示例上进行微调未能弥合这一差距。

sentences.en: However, one model achieves near-zero AG.
sentences.zh: 然而，有一个模型实现了接近零的 AG。

sentences.en: The capability exists within current VLM architectures and depends on pretraining and architectural choices.
sentences.zh: 当前 VLM 架构中就具备这种能力，它取决于预训练和架构选择。

sentences.en: CAGE provides a diagnostic tool for assessing faithful causal reasoning in VLMs.
sentences.zh: CAGE 为评估 VLM 中忠实的因果推理提供了一种诊断工具。

title_en: The Accumulation of Score Estimation Error in Diffusion Models
title_zh: 扩散模型中分数估计误差的累积

sentences.en: Diffusion models are widely used for high-quality generation, but their performance is sensitive to the accuracy of the estimated score.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型被广泛用于高质量生成，但其性能对估计分数的准确性很敏感。

sentences.en: We first derive a stepwise Wasserstein error bound in a Gaussian-mixture setting, where the score admits a closed-form structure, and the score Hessian can be controlled explicitly, leading to sharp Wasserstein estimates.
sentences.zh: 我们首先在混合高斯设定中推导出一个逐步的 Wasserstein 误差界，在该设定下分数具有闭式结构，且分数 Hessian 可以被显式控制，从而得到尖锐的 Wasserstein 估计。

sentences.en: We then extend the analysis to general data distributions, which yields a more general but typically looser upper bound.
sentences.zh: 我们随后将分析扩展到一般数据分布，得到一个更普适但通常更宽松的上界。

sentences.en: This general bound can be sharpened under mild regularity: when the initial distribution has a globally Lipschitz score, the curvature contribution at small times is uniformly bounded, avoiding the worst-case blow-up.
sentences.zh: 这一通用界在温和正则性下可以变得尖锐：当初始分布具有全局 Lipschitz 分数时，小时间下的曲率贡献一致有界，从而避免了最坏情况下的爆炸。

sentences.en: The results hold for both variance-preserving (VP) and variance-exploding (VE) diffusions, and apply to both the reverse-time SDE and the associated probability-flow ODE.
sentences.zh: 这些结果对保方差（VP）和爆发方差（VE）扩散都成立，并同时适用于反向时间 SDE 和相关的概率流 ODE。

title_en: The ACUTE Protocol: Operationalizing Language Model Activations for Better Calibration, Utility, and Trust
title_zh: ACUTE 协议：将语言模型激活用于更好的校准、效用与信任

sentences.en: As language models improve and become increasingly deployed to solve a variety of tasks, trustworthiness becomes essential.
sentences.zh: 随着语言模型的改进并日益被部署来解决各种任务，可信赖性变得至关重要。

sentences.en: Calibration is a good proxy for trust: well-calibrated confidence estimates help inform the risk versus reward trade-off when trusting a specific model output.
sentences.zh: 校准是信任的良好代理指标：校准良好的置信度估计有助于在信任特定模型输出时权衡风险与回报。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, even as models improve, they remain poorly calibrated, often biasing towards overconfidence.
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，即使模型不断改进，它们的校准仍然不佳，往往偏向过度自信。

sentences.en: Additionally, calibration can be gamed: a policy that always predicts the base rate is perfectly calibrated, but completely uninformative.
sentences.zh: 此外，校准可能被利用：一个总是预测基线的策略是完美校准的，但完全无信息量。

sentences.en: To resolve this, we develop a new metric, **expected utility renormalized by the oracle (EURO)**, that balances calibration and informativeness.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一问题，我们开发了一个新指标，**期望效用经预言机重归一化（EURO）**，它在校准与信息量之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: We also propose a general-purpose **activation-based confidence, utility, and trust estimation protocol (ACUTE)** to appropriately adjudicate uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 我们还提出了一种通用的**基于激活的置信度、效用与信任估计协议（ACUTE）**，以恰当地裁定不确定性。

sentences.en: The ACUTE protocol provides flexible, sample-efficient, and compute-efficient confidence estimators for 3 tasks including multiple choice question answering, tool-calling, and scientific document summarization across 6 models from 4 model families.
sentences.zh: ACUTE 协议为 3 项任务提供了灵活、样本高效且计算高效的置信度估计器，涵盖多项选择问答、工具调用和科学文档摘要，跨 4 个模型家族的 6 个模型。

sentences.en: ACUTE outperforms strong baselines on EURO, while maintaining low calibration error.
sentences.zh: ACUTE 在 EURO 上优于强基线，同时保持较低的校准误差。

sentences.en: Taken together, our work shows that equipping LLMs with the ACUTE protocol can improve calibration, utility, and trustworthiness in numerous settings.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，我们的工作表明，为 LLM 配备 ACUTE 协议可以在众多设定中改善校准、效用和可信赖性。

title_en: The Appeal and Reality of Recycling LoRAs with Adaptive Merging
title_zh: 利用自适应合并复用 LoRA 的吸引力与现实

sentences.en: The widespread availability of fine-tuned LoRA modules for open pre-trained models has led to an interest in methods that can adaptively merge LoRAs to improve performance.
sentences.zh: 开源预训练模型的微调 LoRA 模块广泛可用，这引发了人们对能够自适应合并 LoRA 以提升性能的方法的兴趣。

sentences.en: These methods typically include some way of selecting LoRAs from a pool and tune merging coefficients based on a task-specific dataset.
sentences.zh: 这些方法通常包含某种从池中选择 LoRA 的机制，并基于任务特异的数据集调整合并系数。

sentences.en: While adaptive merging methods have demonstrated improvements in some settings, no past work has attempted to recycle LoRAs found ``in the wild'' on model repositories like the Hugging Face Hub.
sentences.zh: 虽然自适应合并在某些设定中已展现出改进，但过去没有任何工作尝试复用在 Hugging Face Hub 等模型仓库中“现实世界”里的 LoRA。

sentences.en: To address this gap, we consider recycling from a pool of nearly 1,000 user-contributed LoRAs trained from the Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct language model.
sentences.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们考虑了从一个由 Llama 3.1 8B-Instruct 语言模型训练出的、近千个用户贡献的 LoRA 池中进行复用。

sentences.en: Our empirical study includes a range of adaptive and non-adaptive merging methods in addition to a new method designed via a wide search over the methodological design space.
sentences.zh: 我们的实证研究涵盖了多种自适应和非自适应合并方法，以及一种通过对方法论设计空间进行广泛搜索而设计的新方法。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that adaptive merging methods can improve performance over the base model but provide limited benefit over training a new LoRA on the same data used to set merging coefficients.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，自适应合并方法能够提升相对基础模型的性能，但相较在用于设定合并系数的同一数据上训练一个新 LoRA，其收益有限。

sentences.en: We additionally find not only that the specific choice of LoRAs to merge has little importance, but that using LoRAs with randomly initialized parameter values yields similar performance.
sentences.zh: 我们另外发现，不仅具体选择哪些 LoRA 进行合并并不重要，而且使用具有随机初始化参数值的 LoRA 也能获得相似性能。

sentences.en: To better understand why past work has proven successful, we confirm that positive transfer is indeed possible when there are highly relevant LoRAs in the pool.
sentences.zh: 为更好地理解过去工作为何成功，我们证实当池中存在高度相关的 LoRA 时，正向迁移确实是可以实现的。

sentences.en: We release the model checkpoints and code online at https://github.com/r-three/realistic-adaptive-merging.
sentences.zh: 我们在 https://github.com/r-three/realistic-adaptive-merging 在线发布了模型检查点和代码。

title_en: The Art of Interrogation: Consistency Amplifies Factuality in Spatial Reasoning
title_zh: 询问的艺术：一致性放大空间推理中的事实性

sentences.en: Current Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) exhibit remarkable general capabilities but significantly underperform in spatial reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 当前的大型推理模型（LRM）展现出卓越的通用能力，但在空间推理任务上明显表现不足。

sentences.en: Existing approaches treat this gap as a knowledge deficit, relying on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to ingest labeled data from external vision sources or synthetic engines.
sentences.zh: 现有方法将这一差距视为知识亏空，依赖监督微调（SFT）从外部视觉源或合成引擎摄取带标签数据。

sentences.en: In contrast, we argue that for many tasks, spatial capabilities are already present in pre-trained LRMs but require alignment through principles of internal logical coherence.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们认为对于许多任务，空间能力已存在于预训练的 LRM 中，只是需要通过内在逻辑一致性的原则进行对齐。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose a self-supervised reinforcement learning (RL) framework that targets the internal Chain-of-Thought (CoT) process without requiring ground-truth annotations.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了一个自监督强化学习（RL）框架，它针对内部的思维链（CoT）过程，而无需真实标注。

sentences.en: By formalizing the notion of consistency verifiers—reward functions that check for geometric and semantic consistency under transformations like flipping or swapping the order of objects in the question—and optimizing them via our new OT-GRPO strategy, a minimal-consistency matching variant of group relative policy optimization, we demonstrate that models can self-correct their spatial logic.
sentences.zh: 通过形式化一致性验证器的概念——即在翻转或交换问题中对象顺序等变换下检查几何和语义一致性的奖励函数——并通过我们新的 OT-GRPO 策略（组相对策略优化的一种最小一致性匹配变体）对它们进行优化，我们证明模型能够自我纠正其空间逻辑。

sentences.en: Our results show that this label-free consistency training approaches the accuracy of models trained with ground-truth supervision and achieves similar generalization across diverse tasks and domains.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，这种无标签的一致性训练接近使用真实监督训练的模型的准确率，并在多样任务和领域上实现类似的泛化。

authors.name: Théo Uscidda
authors.institution: Ecole Nationale de la Statistique et de l'Administration Economique

title_en: The Assistant Axis: Situating and Stabilizing the Default Persona of Language Models
title_zh: 助手轴：定位并稳定语言模型的默认人设

sentences.en: Large language models can represent a variety of personas but typically default to a helpful Assistant identity cultivated during post-training.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型可以代表多种人设，但通常默认采用后训练阶段培养出来的乐于助人的“助手”身份。

sentences.en: Across several different models, we find an “Assistant Axis" in their activation space, which captures the extent to which a model is operating in its default Assistant mode.
sentences.zh: 在多个不同的模型中，我们在其激活空间中发现了一条“助手轴”，它刻画了模型处于默认助手模式的程度。

sentences.en: Steering towards the Assistant direction reinforces helpful and harmless behavior; steering away increases the model’s tendency to identify as other entities.
sentences.zh: 朝向助手方向引导会强化乐于助人且无害的行为；偏离该方向则增加模型将自身识别为其他实体的倾向。

sentences.en: Measuring deviations along the Assistant Axis predicts “persona drift,” a phenomenon where models slip into exhibiting harmful or bizarre behaviors that are uncharacteristic of their typical persona.
sentences.zh: 沿助手轴测量偏差可以预测“人设漂移”，这是一种模型滑入其典型人设所不具有的有害或怪异行为之中的现象。

sentences.en: We find that persona drift is often driven by conversations demanding meta-reflection on the model’s processes or featuring emotionally vulnerable users.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，人设漂移往往由要求对模型自身过程进行元反思，或带有情绪脆弱用户参与的对话所驱动。

sentences.en: We show that restricting activations to a fixed region along the Assistant Axis can stabilize model behavior in these scenarios—and also in the face of adversarial persona-based jailbreaks.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，将激活限制在助手轴上的一个固定区域内，可以稳定这些场景下的模型行为——也能应对基于人设的对抗性越狱。

sentences.en: Our results suggest that post-training steers models toward a particular region of persona space but only loosely tethers them to it, motivating work on training and steering strategies that more deeply anchor models to a coherent persona.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，后训练将模型引向人设空间中的一个特定区域，但只将其松散地拴在该区域上，这激励了更深入地将模型锚定到一致人设之上的训练和引导策略研究。

title_en: The Axiomatic Value of Regularization in AI Alignment from Human Preferences
title_zh: 从人类偏好进行 AI 对齐中正则化的公理化价值

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning from human feedback is the leading approach to aligning powerful AI systems so that they can be safe and helpful for humanity.
sentences.zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习，是使强大 AI 系统对齐以保证其对人类安全且有帮助的主要方法。

sentences.en: While RLHF is typically modelled as a problem of learning a single preference ranking from noisy feedback, true human preferences are complex and often conflicting, representing substantive disagreements stemming from the diversity of individual human values.
sentences.zh: 虽然 RLHF 通常被建模为从含噪反馈中学习单一偏好排序的问题，但真实的人类偏好是复杂且往往相互冲突的，代表了源自个体人类价值观多样性的实质性分歧。

sentences.en: With this motivation, a recent line of research has studied RLHF from the perspective of social choice theory, which provides a set of well-established desirable properties for aggregating diverse preferences.
sentences.zh: 基于这一动机，近期一系列研究从社会选择理论的角度审视 RLHF，该理论为聚合多样化偏好提供了一组公认的理想性质。

sentences.en: Seen through this lens, the standard learning objective in RLHF is equivalent to aggregating diverse human preferences via the Borda count rule.
sentences.zh: 透过这一视角，RLHF 中的标准学习目标等价于通过 Borda 计数规则来聚合多样化的人类偏好。

sentences.en: At the same time, several new RLHF algorithms have been proposed, which turn out to be equivalent to the von Neumann winner social choice rule.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，人们提出了几种新的 RLHF 算法，它们被证明等价于 von Neumann 胜者的社会选择规则。

sentences.en: However, the connection between social choice theory and RLHF has thus far ignored the critical role of regularization to prevent divergence from a reference policy, which is utilized in essentially all practical RLHF algorithms.
sentences.zh: 然而，社会选择理论与 RLHF 之间的联系迄今为止忽略了正则化在防止偏离参考策略方面的关键作用，而几乎所有实用 RLHF 算法都会使用这种正则化。

sentences.en: In this paper, we study how regularization affects the social choice axioms satisfied by different RLHF algorithms, and prove that regularization improves the axiomatic properties of the von Neumann winner rule.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了正则化如何影响不同 RLHF 算法所满足的社会选择公理，并证明了正则化改善了 von Neumann 胜者规则的公理化性质。

sentences.en: In contrast, the Borda count rule still fails to satisfy key social choice axioms even when regularized.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，即使经过正则化，Borda 计数规则仍然无法满足关键的社会选择公理。

sentences.en: These results provide a principled argument grounded in social choice theory for utilizing practical RLHF algorithms that correspond to the von Neumann winner, rather than the standard RLHF objective.
sentences.zh: 这些结果为使用对应于 von Neumann 胜者而非标准 RLHF 目标的实用 RLHF 算法，提供了一个扎根于社会选择理论的原则性论证。

title_en: The benefits of full data shuffle, now with optimal I/O cost: $k$-wise independence and matrix transposition to the rescue
title_zh: 全量数据洗牌的好处，如今具备最优 I/O 成本：$k$-wise 独立性与矩阵转置来救场

sentences.en: It is known that RandomShuffle, the without replacement version of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD), converges faster than with replacement SGD.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，RandomShuffle——随机梯度下降（SGD）的无放回版本——比有放回 SGD 收敛得更快。

sentences.en: However, RandomShuffle requires uniformly performing a random permutation of the input sequence, which is known to have high I/O complexity due to data movement across the memory hierarchy.
sentences.zh: 然而，RandomShuffle 需要统一地对输入序列进行随机排列，而由于数据在内存层级间的移动，这具有很高的 I/O 复杂度。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose a shuffling algorithm with a linear I/O complexity that generates almost-uniformly random permutations with rigorous mathematical guarantees.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了一种线性 I/O 复杂度的洗牌算法，它能以严格的数学保证生成几乎均匀的随机排列。

sentences.en: Specifically, we show that the shuffling algorithm can generate $2$-wise independent permutations.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们表明该洗牌算法能够生成 $2$-wise 独立排列。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we can extend to $k$-wise independence with a small error in the probability distribution, if the fast memory has at least $k$ memory blocks.
sentences.zh: 此外，如果快速内存至少有 $k$ 个内存块，我们可以将其扩展到 $k$-wise 独立性，且概率分布只有很小的误差。

sentences.en: These results allow us to reach the same expected theoretical convergence as RandomShuffle while achieving optimal linear I/O cost.
sentences.zh: 这些结果使我们能够达到与 RandomShuffle 相同的期望理论收敛，同时实现最优的线性 I/O 成本。

authors.name: Rezaul Chowdhury
authors.institution: State University of New York at Stony Brook

title_en: The Bridge-Garden Dilemma in LLM Distillation: Why Mixing Hard and Soft Labels Works
title_zh: LLM 蒸馏中的桥-园困境：为何混合硬标签和软标签有效

sentences.en: Knowledge distillation (KD) transfers knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller student.
sentences.zh: 知识蒸馏（KD）将知识从大型教师模型迁移到较小的学生模型。

sentences.en: In language modeling, the student is trained either on tokens sampled from the teacher (\textbf{hard labels}) or the teacher’s full next-token distribution (\textbf{soft labels}).
sentences.zh: 在语言建模中，学生模型要么在从教师采样的词元（\textbf{硬标签}）上训练，要么在教师的完整下一个词元分布（\textbf{软标签}）上训练。

sentences.en: Despite soft labels appear strictly richer, we find that mixing hard and soft labels consistently yields better results.
sentences.zh: 尽管软标签看起来严格更丰富，我们发现混合硬标签和软标签总能获得更好的结果。

sentences.en: Crucially, we show that this gain cannot be explained by closer teacher matching during training.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，我们表明这一增益无法用训练期间更接近教师的匹配来解释。

sentences.en: Instead, it comes from reduced exposure bias---the mismatch between training and inference distributions.
sentences.zh: 相反，它来源于曝光偏差的降低——即训练与推断分布之间的不匹配。

sentences.en: To explain this phenomenon, we introduce the Bridge–Garden Decomposition theory, which categorizes generation steps into two types: \textit{Bridges}, where the next token must be \textit{exact}, and \textit{Gardens}, where it can be \textit{flexible}.
sentences.zh: 为解释这一现象，我们引入了桥-园分解理论，它将生成步骤分为两类：\textit{桥}\，其中下一个词元必须是\textit{精确}\的；以及\textit{园}\，其中下一个词元可以是\textit{灵活}\的。

sentences.en: We show that hard-only KD excels in Bridges by avoiding risky deviations, while soft-only KD preserves diversity in Gardens.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，纯硬标签 KD 通过避免有风险的偏离而在桥中表现出色，而纯软标签 KD 则在园中保持了多样性。

sentences.en: A hybrid strategy handles both cases and, as a result, reduces exposure bias across the sequence.
sentences.zh: 混合策略能同时处理这两种情况，因此能减少整个序列上的曝光偏差。

sentences.en: Guided by this theory, we develop a family of Bridge--Garden hybrid supervision methods that adaptively balance hard and soft labels.
sentences.zh: 在这一理论的指导下，我们开发了一系列桥-园混合监督方法，自适应地平衡硬标签和软标签。

sentences.en: Across seven teacher--student pairs (including Qwen, Llama, Gemma, and DeepSeek) and benchmarks in reasoning and coding, our approach outperforms divergence-based and on-policy KD baselines while reducing training cost by \textbf{9.7$\times$}, enabling efficient model compression.
sentences.zh: 跨七个师生对（包括 Qwen、Llama、Gemma 和 DeepSeek）以及推理和编码基准，我们的方法优于基于散度和在策略的 KD 基线，同时将训练成本降低\textbf{9.7$\times$}\，从而实现高效的模型压缩。

title_en: The Catastrophic Failure of *the* k-Means Algorithm in High Dimensions, and How Hartigan's Algorithm Avoids It
title_zh: *the* k 均值算法在高维中的灾难性失败，以及 Hartigan 算法如何避免它

sentences.en: Lloyd's k-means algorithm is one of the most widely used clustering methods.
sentences.zh: Lloyd 的 k 均值算法是最广泛使用的聚类方法之一。

sentences.en: We prove that in high-dimensional, high-noise settings, the algorithm exhibits catastrophic failure: with high probability, essentially every partition of the data is a fixed point.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在高维、高噪声设定中，该算法会表现出灾难性失败：以高概率，数据的几乎每个划分都是不动点。

sentences.en: Consequently, Lloyd's algorithm simply returns its initial partition — even when the underlying clusters are trivially recoverable by other methods.
sentences.zh: 因此，Lloyd 算法只是返回其初始划分——即使底层聚类可以被其他方法毫不费力地恢复。

sentences.en: In contrast, we prove that Hartigan's k-means algorithm does not exhibit this pathology.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，我们证明 Hartigan 的 k 均值算法不会表现出这种病理现象。

sentences.en: Our results show the stark difference between these algorithms and offer a theoretical explanation for the empirical difficulties often observed with k-means in high dimensions.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果揭示了这两种算法之间的鲜明差异，并为高维 k 均值经常观察到的经验困难提供了一种理论解释。

title_en: The Choice of Normalization Influences Shrinkage in Regularized Regression
title_zh: 归一化方式的选择影响正则化回归中的收缩

sentences.en: Regularized models are often sensitive to the scales of the features in the data and it has therefore become standard practice to normalize (center and scale) the features before fitting the model.
sentences.zh: 正则化模型往往对数据中特征的尺度敏感，因此，在拟合模型之前对特征进行归一化（居中并缩放）已成为标准做法。

sentences.en: But there are many different ways to normalize the features and the choice may have dramatic effects on the resulting model.
sentences.zh: 但归一化特征的方式有很多种，而该选择可能对最终模型产生显著影响。

sentences.en: In spite of this, there has so far been no research on this topic.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，到目前为止，还没有关于这一主题的研究。

sentences.en: In this paper, we begin to bridge this knowledge gap by studying normalization in the context of lasso, ridge, and elastic net regression.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们开始弥合这一知识空白，研究 lasso、ridge 和弹性网络回归语境下的归一化。

sentences.en: We focus on binary features and show that their class balances (proportions of ones) directly influences the regression coefficients and that this effect depends on the combination of normalization and regularization methods used.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦于二元特征，并表明其类别平衡（1 的比例）直接影响回归系数，且该效应取决于所使用的归一化与正则化方法的组合。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that this effect can be mitigated by scaling binary features with their variance in the case of the lasso and standard deviation in the case of ridge regression, but that this comes at the cost of increased variance of the coefficient estimates.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，在 lasso 情形下用二元特征的方差进行缩放、在 ridge 回归中用标准差进行缩放，可以减轻这种效应，但这是以系数估计方差增大为代价的。

sentences.en: For the elastic net, we show that scaling the penalty weights, rather than the features, can achieve the same effect.
sentences.zh: 对于弹性网络，我们表明缩放惩罚权重而非特征本身，也能达到同样的效果。

sentences.en: Finally, we also tackle mixes of binary and normal features as well as interactions and provide some initial results on how to normalize features in these cases.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们还处理了二元特征与正态特征的混合以及交互项，并为这些情况下如何归一化特征提供了一些初步结果。

authors.name: Johan Larsson
authors.institution: Department of Mathematical Sciences, University of Copenhagen

title_en: The Consistency Dilemma in LLMs: Generator-Evaluator Agreement and Vulnerability to Mistakes
title_zh: LLM 中的一致性困境：生成器-评估器一致性及对错误的脆弱性

sentences.en: Large language models are increasingly deployed in agentic pipelines that depend on the model evaluating its own outputs without external verification.
sentences.zh: 大型语言模型日益被部署在依赖模型在没有外部验证的情况下评估自身输出的智能体流水线中。

sentences.en: The reliability of these pipelines depends on an implicit assumption: that the model applies relevant concepts the same way when it generates an output and later evaluates that output.
sentences.zh: 这些流水线的可靠性依赖于一个隐含假设：模型在生成输出和稍后评估该输出时，会以相同方式应用相关概念。

sentences.en: We propose a new measure, *generator–evaluator self-consistency*, to test this assumption directly and apply it to 10 frontier models across 491 concepts.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了一种新度量，*生成器-评估器自致性*，用于直接检验这一假设，并将其应用于 491 个概念上的 10 个前沿模型。

sentences.en: We find, first, that there is substantial variation in self-consistency.
sentences.zh: 我们首先发现，自致性存在显著差异。

sentences.en: Second, we find that in a clinical setting with physician-validated mistakes (Proniakin et al., 2025), across models, those with higher self-consistency are linked to *greater* vulnerability to mistakes.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们发现，在具有医生验证错误的临床环境中（Proniakin 等人，2025），跨模型而言，自致性较高的模型与对错误*更大*的脆弱性相关联。

sentences.en: Thus, even when models consistently apply concepts they may not be safe to deploy.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使模型能一致地应用概念，它们也可能不适合部署。

sentences.en: This is evidence of a *consistency dilemma* in LLMs: self-consistency is operationally useful, but models that are more consistent are also more prone to mistakes.
sentences.zh: 这是 LLM 中*一致性困境*的证据：自致性在操作上有用，但更一致的模型也更易于出错。

title_en: The Convergent Representation of Contrastive Vision-Language Models: Geometry, Modality Gap and Shared Space Alignment
title_zh: 对比视觉-语言模型的收敛表示：几何、模态差距与共享空间对齐

sentences.en: Multimodal contrastive learning (MCL) aims to embed data from two modalities in a shared embedding space.
sentences.zh: 多模态对比学习（MCL）旨在将两个模态的数据嵌入到共享嵌入空间中。

sentences.en: However, in practice, image and text representations occupy completely separated regions of the embedding space, a phenomenon called the modality gap.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，图像和文本表示占据了嵌入空间中完全分离的区域，这一现象被称为模态差距。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, empirical findings on how the modality gap affects downstream performance remain inconsistent.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，关于模态差距如何影响下游性能的实证发现仍然不一致。

sentences.en: These observations motivate two key questions: (1) What causes the modality gap?
sentences.zh: 这些观察催生了两个关键问题：（1）是什么导致了模态差距？

sentences.en: (2) What determines downstream performance?
sentences.zh: （2）什么决定了下游性能？

sentences.en: To address these questions, we develop the first theoretical framework for analyzing the geometry of convergent optimal representations (COR) of MCL when training is optimized.
sentences.zh: 为回答这些问题，我们开发了第一个用于分析 MCL 在训练优化至收敛时的收敛最优表示（COR）几何的理论框架。

sentences.en: We prove that the modality gap emerges when image and text representations collapse into different subspaces, a phenomenon called \emph{dimension collapse}.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，当图像和文本表示坍缩到不同的子空间时，模态差距就会出现，这一现象被称为\emph{维度坍缩}\。

sentences.en: Our theory further reveals that although the modality gap prevents direct alignment between image and text representations, their projections onto the shared subspace can align.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论进一步揭示，虽然模态差距阻碍了图像和文本表示之间的直接对齐，但它们在共享子空间上的投影能够对齐。

sentences.en: Moreover, we show that shared space alignment is a dominant factor in downstream performance, while the effect of the modality gap is limited.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们表明共享空间对齐是下游性能的主导因素，而模态差距的影响是有限的。

sentences.en: Inspired by these findings, we propose Shared Space Alignment (SSA) to improve MCL pretraining by enhancing alignment in the shared space without optimizing for modality gap reduction.
sentences.zh: 受这些发现的启发，我们提出了共享空间对齐（SSA），通过在不优化模态差距缩减的情况下增强共享空间中的对齐，来改进 MCL 预训练。

sentences.en: Extensive empirical results validate our theoretical analysis and the proposed method.
sentences.zh: 大量实证结果验证了我们的理论分析和所提出的方法。

authors.name: Lingjie Yi
authors.institution: State University of New York at Stony Brook

title_en: The Cost of Commitment in Option-Based Hierarchical RL
title_zh: 基于选项的分层强化学习中承诺的代价

sentences.en: Empirically, option-based hierarchical reinforcement (HRL) learning often produces longer and more diverse options when a deliberation cost is charged at option boundaries.
sentences.zh: 实证上，基于选项的分层强化学习（HRL）在选项边界处收取深思熟虑成本时，往往会产生更长且更多样化的选项。

sentences.en: However, when options are executed for many steps under an approximate dynamics model, small model errors compound along the option, degrading the quality of the resulting plan.
sentences.zh: 然而，当选项在近似动力学模型下执行许多步时，小的模型误差会沿选项累积，损害最终计划的质量。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce the commitment loss to formalize the tradeoff between deliberation cost and model error as a function of option duration.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们引入了承诺损失，将深思熟虑成本与模型误差之间的权衡形式化为选项时长的函数。

sentences.en: We characterize how optimal termination probabilities vary with this tradeoff under two model-error mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 我们刻画了在两种模型误差机制下，最优终止概率如何随这一权衡变化。

sentences.en: First, the model is learned from finite data via maximum-likelihood estimation, producing statistical error that interacts with option duration.
sentences.zh: 首先，模型通过最大似然估计从有限数据中学习，产生与选项时长相互作用的统计误差。

sentences.en: Second, we consider an input-driven setting where an exogenous input is only observed at option boundaries and evolves unobserved between them, creating a drift-induced mismatch between planned and realized dynamics.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们考虑一种输入驱动设定，其中外生输入仅在选项边界处被观测到，并在边界之间隐式演化不引人注意，从而在计划与实现的动力学之间产生漂移引起的不匹配。

sentences.en: In both cases, we solve for the optimal termination behavior as a function of deliberation cost and the error scale, clarifying the behavior of some popular HRL algorithms that approach the deliberation cost as a heuristic.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，我们都求解了作为深思熟虑成本和误差尺度函数的最优终止行为，阐明了某些将沉思熟虑成本当作启发式的流行 HRL 算法的行为。

title_en: The Cost of Information: Phase Transitions in Contextual Bandits with Paid Observations
title_zh: 信息的代价：带付费观测的上下文老虎机中的相变

sentences.en: We study contextual bandits with paid observations, where the learner actively chooses which actions to observe at a given cost in each round, with the goal of minimizing total regret that jointly accounts for learning loss and observation expenditure.
sentences.zh: 我们研究带付费观测的上下文老虎机，其中学习者在每一轮主动选择以给定成本观测哪些动作，目标是最小化同时计入学习损失和观测支出的总遗憾。

sentences.en: We develop a near-optimal algorithm for adversarial environments and show that even small observation costs fundamentally raise the minimax regret order.
sentences.zh: 我们为对抗性环境开发了一种近似最优的算法，并表明即使很小的观测成本也会从根本上提高极小极大遗憾阶。

sentences.en: We further uncover a novel phase transition under a free observation budget: below a critical threshold, free observations only reduce total cost without improving the regret rate; above it, asymptotic improvements become possible.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在一个免费观测预算下揭示了一个新颖的相变：低于某个临界阈值时，免费观测只会降低总成本而不会改善遗憾率；高于该阈值时，渐近改进成为可能。

sentences.en: To exploit this phenomenon, we design a meta-controller that adaptively switches between strategies to achieve near-optimal performance across all budget regimes.
sentences.zh: 为利用这一现象，我们设计了一个元控制器，自适应地在不同策略之间切换，以在所有预算体制下实现近似最优性能。

sentences.en: To handle large or infinite policy spaces, we also propose an oracle-efficient algorithm under a function approximation framework that maintains rigorous guarantees with computational efficiency.
sentences.zh: 为处理大型或无限的策略空间，我们还在函数近似框架下提出了一种预言机高效的算法，在保持严格保证的同时兼顾计算效率。

sentences.en: Our analysis also connects to related problems including switching costs, budgeted constraints, model misspecification, and knapsack bandits.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析还联系到相关问题，包括切换成本、预算约束、模型误设定和背包老虎机。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments validate our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 数值实验验证了我们的理论发现。

title_en: The Cost of Learning Under Multiple Change Points
title_zh: 多个变化点下学习的代价

sentences.en: We consider an online learning problem in environments with multiple change points.
sentences.zh: 我们考虑具有多个变化点的环境中的在线学习问题。

sentences.en: In contrast to the single change point problem that is widely studied using classical "high confidence" detection schemes, the multiple change point environment presents new learning-theoretic and algorithmic challenges.
sentences.zh: 与使用经典“高置信”检测方案被广泛研究的单一变化点问题相比，多变化点环境带来了新的学习理论与算法挑战。

sentences.en: Specifically, we show that classical methods may exhibit catastrophic failure (high regret) due to a phenomenon we refer to as  endogenous confounding.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们表明，由于我们称之为内生混杂的现象，经典方法可能表现出灾难性失效（高遗憾）。

sentences.en: To overcome this, we propose a new class of learning algorithms dubbed Anytime Tracking CUSUM (ATC).
sentences.zh: 为克服这一点，我们提出了一类新的学习算法，称为任意时间跟踪 CUSUM（ATC）。

sentences.en: These are horizon-free online algorithms that implement a selective detection principle, balancing the need to ignore "small" (hard-to-detect) shifts, while reacting "quickly" to significant ones.
sentences.zh: 这些是无视视界的在线算法，实现了选择性检测原则，在忽略“微小”（难以检测的）偏移与对显著偏移“快速”反应之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: We prove that the performance of a properly tuned ATC algorithm is nearly minimax-optimal;  its regret is guaranteed to closely match a novel information-theoretic lower bound on the achievable performance of any learning algorithm in the multiple change point problem.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，经过恰当调优的 ATC 算法的性能接近极小极大最优；其遗憾被保证能紧密匹配一个新颖的信息论下界，该下界刻画了任何学习算法在多变化点问题中可达到的性能。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic as well as real-world data validate the aforementioned theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 在合成数据和真实世界数据上的实验验证了上述理论发现。

title_en: The Crowded Embedding Space: A Mean-Field Mechanism for Emergent Marginalization in Retrieval-Augmented Agents
title_zh: 拥挤的嵌入空间：检索增强智能体涌现性边缘化的均场机制

sentences.en: Retrieval-augmented generative agents rely on retrieval for grounding, yet are typically evaluated on a query-by-query basis.
sentences.zh: 检索增强的生成智能体依赖检索来进行接地，但通常按查询逐条评估。

sentences.en: This isolates interactions that are geometrically coupled in a shared embedding space.
sentences.zh: 这分离了在共享嵌入空间中几何上耦合的交互。

sentences.en: For example, we show that the high document density required to serve majority interests (e.g., generic "Crime" movies) can geometrically overcrowd the retrieval neighborhood of a semantically similar minority (e.g., "Film Noir"), effectively expelling minority content from top-$k$ results.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们表明，服务于多数群体利益所需的高文档密度（例如泛泛的“犯罪”电影）会在几何上挤占语义相似的少数群体（例如“黑色电影”）的检索邻域，有效地将少数群体内容排挤出 top-$k$ 结果。

sentences.en: We introduce a formal framework to analyze how such *goal collisions* in dense retrieval induce fundamental performance limits and emergent fairness issues inherent to spatial crowding.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个形式化框架来分析稠密检索中此类*目标碰撞*如何引发根本性的性能极限，以及空间拥挤所固有的涌现公平性问题。

sentences.en: In our static analysis, we demonstrate that for a fixed embedding space, a phase transition occurs where minority user goals suffer a catastrophic collapse in performance as the density of majority goals increases.
sentences.zh: 在我们的静态分析中，我们证明，对于一个固定的嵌入空间，存在一个相变，即随着多数目标密度的增加，少数群体用户目标会遭遇灾难性的性能坍缩。

sentences.en: We then extend this to a dynamic model and derive a non-linear Fokker-Planck equation that governs the evolution of document embeddings as the agent updates them to maximize retrieval accuracy.
sentences.zh: 我们随后将其扩展到动态模型，并推导出一个非线性 Fokker-Planck 方程，它刻画了智能体为最大化检索准确率而更新文档嵌入时，嵌入的演化规律。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that this local relevance objective triggers an emergent global mechanism that systematically marginalizes minority interests.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示，这种局部相关性目标会触发一种系统性地边缘化少数群体利益的涌现全局机制。

sentences.en: We prove that such objectives drive the system to self-organize into a state that exclusively serves majority interests.
sentences.zh: 我们证明，此类目标会驱使系统自组织到一个只服务多数群体利益的状态。

sentences.en: These results provide a theoretical foundation for understanding a critical grounding failure mode in retrieval-augmented agents.
sentences.zh: 这些结果为理解检索增强智能体中一个关键的接地失败模式提供了理论基础。

title_en: The Cylindrical Representation Hypothesis for Language Model Steering
title_zh: 用于语言模型引导的柱面表示假说

sentences.en: Steering is widely used for controlling large language models, yet its effects are often unstable and difficult to predict.
sentences.zh: 引导被广泛用于控制大型语言模型，但其效果往往不稳定且难以预测。

sentences.en: Existing theoretical accounts are largely based on the Linear Representation Hypothesis (LRH), which assumes that concepts can be orthogonalized for lossless control.
sentences.zh: 现有的理论解释大多基于线性表示假说（LRH），它假设概念可以被正交化以实现无损失的控制。

sentences.en: However, this assumption rarely holds in practice and cannot explain the variability of steering outcomes.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一假设在实践中很少成立，也无法解释引导结果的变异性。

sentences.en: We propose the Cylindrical Representation Hypothesis (CRH), a geometric extension of LRH that relaxes the orthogonality assumption while preserving linear concept representations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了柱面表示假说（CRH），它是 LRH 的一种几何扩展，在保留线性概念表示的同时放宽了正交性假设。

sentences.en: We show that overlapping concept contributions naturally induce a sample-specific cylindrical structure consisting of a central axis, a normal plane, and sensitive sectors.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，重叠的概念贡献会自然地诱导出一种样本特异的柱面结构，由一条中心轴、一个法平面和若干敏感扇区组成。

sentences.en: The central axis captures the primary semantic transition associated with a target concept, while the normal plane governs steering sensitivity.
sentences.zh: 中心轴捕获与目标概念相关的首要语义转变，而法平面控制引导敏感性。

sentences.en: Within this plane, some sectors facilitate concept activation, while others suppress or delay it.
sentences.zh: 在该平面内，一些扇区促进概念激活，另一些则抑制或延迟它。

sentences.en: CRH reveals an asymmetry in steering predictability: the normal plane can be inferred from difference vectors, but the sensitive sectors cannot, introducing an intrinsic source of uncertainty.
sentences.zh: CRH 揭示了引导可预测性中的一种不对称性：法平面可以从差分向量中推断出来，但敏感扇区不能，从而引入了不确定性的内在来源。

sentences.en: This explains why steering outcomes vary across samples even when intervention directions are well aligned.
sentences.zh: 这解释了为何即使在干预方向对齐良好时，引导结果也因样本而异。

sentences.en: Experiments spanning 100 concepts, multiple models, and diverse steering methods provide consistent evidence for the predicted cylindrical structure, suggesting that steering variability arises from representation geometry rather than imperfect steering vectors.
sentences.zh: 覆盖 100 个概念、多个模型和多种引导方法的实验，为所预测的柱面结构提供了一致的证据，表明引导变异性源于表示几何，而非不完美的引导向量。

sentences.en: Our code is available at: https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/CRH.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/mbzuai-nlp/CRH。

title_en: The Data Manifold under the Microscope
title_zh: 显微镜下的数据流形

sentences.en: A significant gap exists between theory and practice in deep learning.
sentences.zh: 深度学习的理论与实践之间存在显著差距。

sentences.en: Generalization and approximation error bounds are often derived for simplified models or are too loose to be informative.
sentences.zh: 泛化和近似误差界通常是针对简化模型推导的，或者过于宽松而缺乏信息量。

sentences.en: Many rely on the manifold hypothesis and on geometric regularity such as intrinsic dimension, curvature, and reach.
sentences.zh: 许多工作依赖于流形假说以及诸如内在维度、曲率和 reach 之类的几何正则性。

sentences.en: Progress requires insight into data-manifold geometry and suitable benchmarks, yet existing options are polarized: analytic manifolds with known geometry but limited applicability, or real-world datasets where geometry is only coarsely estimable.
sentences.zh: 取得进展需要对数据流形几何的洞见和合适的基准，但现有选择是两极化的：要么是已知几何但适用性有限的解析流形，要么是无法精细估计几何的真实世界数据集。

sentences.en: We introduce a benchmarking framework for studying data geometry.
sentences.zh: 我们引入了一个用于研究数据几何的基准测试框架。

sentences.en: We repurpose and extend dSprites and COIL-20 with additional transformation dimensions and dense, axis-aligned sampling, and pair them with finite-difference estimators that recover curvature, reach, and volume at near-ground-truth accuracy in a regime where general-purpose estimators are unreliable or difficult to deploy.
sentences.zh: 我们重新利用并扩展了 dSprites 和 COIL-20，加入额外的变换维度和稠密的轴对齐采样，并配以有限差分估计器，后者在通用估计器不可靠或难以部署的领域，能够以接近真值的准确率恢复曲率、reach 和体积。

sentences.en: The framework is intended as a controlled testbed, useful as a calibration environment for geometric estimators and a sandbox for probing theoretical assumptions.
sentences.zh: 该框架旨在作为一个受控测试平台，可用作几何估计器的校准环境，以及检验理论假设的沙盒。

sentences.en: To illustrate its use, we present two application studies, namely assessing the scaling behavior of the bounds of Genovese et al. and Fefferman et al., and tracking the layer-wise geometry of a $\beta$-VAE, highlighting the behavior of current bounds and the value of controlled benchmarks for guiding and validating future theory.
sentences.zh: 为说明其用途，我们展示了两项应用研究，即评估 Genovese 等人和 Fefferman 等人的界的扩展行为，以及跟踪 $\beta$-VAE 的逐层几何，突出当前界的行为以及受控基准对指导和验证未来理论的价值。

sentences.en: A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/koulakis/manifold-microscope.
sentences.zh: 参考实现可在 https://github.com/koulakis/manifold-microscope 获取。

title_en: The Decrypto Benchmark for Multi-Agent Reasoning and Theory of Mind
title_zh: 面向多智能体推理与心智理论的 Decrypto 基准测试

sentences.en: As Large Language Models (LLMs) gain agentic abilities, they will have to navigate complex multi-agent scenarios, interacting with human users and other agents in cooperative and competitive settings.
sentences.zh: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）获得智能体能力，它们将不得不应对复杂的多智能体场景，在合作与竞争环境中与人类用户和其他智能体交互。

sentences.en: This will require new reasoning skills, a crucial one being theory of mind (ToM), or the ability to reason about the ``mental'' states of other agents.
sentences.zh: 这将需要新的推理技能，其中关键的一项就是心智理论（ToM），即对其他智能体的“心理”状态进行推理的能力。

sentences.en: However, ToM and other multi-agent abilities in LLMs are poorly understood, since existing benchmarks suffer from narrow scope, data leakage, saturation, and lack of interactivity.
sentences.zh: 然而，LLM 中的 ToM 和其他多智能体能力尚未被充分理解，因为现有基准存在范围狭窄、数据泄漏、饱和以及缺乏交互性等问题。

sentences.en: We thus propose Decrypto, a game-based benchmark for multi-agent reasoning and ToM drawing inspiration from cognitive science, computational pragmatics and multi-agent reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出了 Decrypto，一个基于游戏的多智能体推理与 ToM 基准，其灵感来自认知科学、计算语用学和多智能体强化学习。

sentences.en: It is designed to be as easy as possible in all other dimensions, eliminating confounding factors common in other benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 该基准被设计为在所有其他维度上尽可能简单，消除了其他基准中常见的混杂因素。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, it is also the first platform that isolates ToM evaluation in an interactive setting.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，它也是第一个在交互式设定中隔离 ToM 评估的平台。

sentences.en: We validate the benchmark design through comprehensive empirical evaluations of frontier LLMs, robustness studies, and human-AI cross-play experiments.
sentences.zh: 我们通过对前沿 LLM 的全面实证评估、鲁棒性研究和人-AI 交叉博弈实验，验证了该基准的设计。

sentences.en: We find that LLMs lag behind humans and simple word-embedding baselines on key game metrics.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，在关键游戏指标上，LLM 落后于人类和简单的词嵌入基线。

sentences.en: We then create variants of two classic cognitive science experiments within Decrypto to evaluate three distinct ToM abilities.
sentences.zh: 随后，我们在 Decrypto 内创建了两个经典认知科学实验的变体，以评估三种不同的 ToM 能力。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, our results show that state-of-the-art reasoning models are significantly worse at those tasks than their older counterparts.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，我们的结果表明，最先进的推理模型在这些任务上明显差于它们较旧的同类模型。

sentences.en: This demonstrates that Decrypto addresses a crucial gap in current reasoning and ToM evaluations, and paves the path towards better artificial agents.
sentences.zh: 这表明 Decrypto 弥补了当前推理与 ToM 评估中的一个关键空白，并为更优秀的人工智能体铺平了道路。

sentences.en: Code at https://github.com/facebookresearch/decrypto.
sentences.zh: 代码见 https://github.com/facebookresearch/decrypto。

title_en: The Deterministic Horizon: When Extended Reasoning Fails and Tool Delegation Becomes Necessary
title_zh: 确定性视界：当扩展推理失效而工具委托成为必要时

sentences.en: Extended chain-of-thought reasoning can degrade performance on deterministic state-tracking tasks, not due to preference biases, but limits rooted in the information-theoretic capacity of decoder-only attention.
sentences.zh: 扩展思维链推理可能降低确定性状态跟踪任务上的性能，这不是由于偏好偏差，而是根源于仅解码器注意力的信息论容量限制。

sentences.en: We establish: (1) an Attention Bottleneck Theorem with a complementary achievability construction, bounding state-tracking capacity as $O(H \cdot \log(L/H) \cdot \sqrt{d_h})$; (2) a context-dependent error model yielding super-exponential accuracy decay; (3) the State-Space Jaccard metric distinguishing capability from preference failures; (4) a Deterministic Horizon $d^* \in [19, 31]$ beyond which tool delegation becomes necessary.
sentences.zh: 我们确立了：（1）一个注意力瓶颈定理及一个互补的可达性构造，将状态跟踪容量界定为 $O(H \cdot \log(L/H) \cdot \sqrt{d_h})$；（2）一个产生超指数准确率衰减的上下文相关误差模型；（3）用于区分能力失败与偏好失败的 State-Space Jaccard 度量；（4）一个确定性视界 $d^* \in [19, 31]$，超出它之后工具委托变得必要。

sentences.en: Across 12 models and 8 task domains (including SWE-Bench, WebArena, and SQL-Multi), tool-integrated reasoning consistently outperforms neural chain-of-thought; on the primary model suite it reaches 86–94% accuracy versus 24–42% for neural chain-of-thought.
sentences.zh: 跨 12 个模型和 8 个任务领域（包括 SWE-Bench、WebArena 和 SQL-Multi），整合工具的推理始终优于神经推理思维链；在主要模型套件上，它达到 86-94% 的准确率，而神经思维链为 24-42%。

sentences.en: Fine-tuning on optimal-length traces yields $<$5% improvement, confirming an architectural ceiling, and high cross-model correlation ($r = 0.81$–$0.91$) indicates these failures are architectural rather than training-specific.
sentences.zh: 在最优长度轨迹上微调仅带来 $<$5% 的提升，证实了一个架构上限，而高跨模型相关性（$r = 0.81$-$0.91$）表明这些失败是架构性的，而非训练特异的。

sentences.en: Our results provide principled guidance for when pure neural reasoning should yield to hybrid approaches in agentic systems.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果为智能体系统中纯神经推理何时应当让位于混合方法，提供了有原则的指导。

title_en: The Devil is in the Condition Numbers: Why is GLU Better than non-GLU Structure?
title_zh: 魔鬼在条件数中：为何 GLU 优于非 GLU 结构？

sentences.en: Gated Linear Units (GLU) and their variants are widely adopted in modern open-source large language model architectures and consistently outperform their non-gated counterparts, yet the underlying reasons for this advantage remain unclear.
sentences.zh: 门控线性单元（GLU）及其变体在现代开源大型语言模型架构中被广泛采用，并且始终优于其非门控对应物，但这种优势的根本原因仍然不清楚。

sentences.en: In this work, we study GLU by analyzing two-layer networks in the neural tangent kernel (NTK) regime.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们在神经正切核（NTK）机制下通过分析两层网络来研究 GLU。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that the GLU structure reshapes the NTK spectrum, leading to a smaller condition number and a more compact eigenvalue distribution.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示，GLU 结构重塑了 NTK 谱，带来更小的条件数和更紧凑的特征值分布。

sentences.en: Building on this finding, we further analyze the resulting training dynamics and show how the reshaped spectrum leads to faster convergence of GLU models, including a characteristic loss-crossing phenomenon observed between GLU and non-GLU models.
sentences.zh: 基于这一发现，我们进一步分析由此产生的训练动力学，并展示重塑后的谱如何带来 GLU 模型更快的收敛，包括在 GLU 与非 GLU 模型之间观察到的特征性损失交叉现象。

sentences.en: Finally, we empirically observe that GLU has limited impact in reducing the generalization gap on various models, including ViT and GPT-2, suggesting that its primary benefit lies in accelerating optimization rather than reducing the generalization gap.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们实证观察到，GLU 在缩小各种模型（包括 ViT 和 GPT-2）的泛化差距方面影响有限，这表明其主要益处在于加速优化，而非缩小泛化差距。

sentences.en: The code is available at: https://github.com/Zemdalk/GLU-NTK.
sentences.zh: 代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/Zemdalk/GLU-NTK。
